message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules**

**Objective**  
Be the first player to score 500 points (or a different agreed‑upon total). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and by collecting the cards in other players’ hands when they finish.

---

### 1. Setup

| Item | Quantity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Deck | 108 cards | Standard Uno deck (4 colors × 25 cards each + 8 Wild cards) |
| Players | 2–10 | Each player gets 7 cards |
| Discard pile | 1 | Start with top card of shuffled deck |
| Draw pile | 1 | Remaining cards face down |

**Procedure**

1. Shuffle the full deck thoroughly.  
2. Deal 7 cards to each player, face down.  
3. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile.  
   * If it’s a special card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), apply its effect immediately to the first player (see §3).  
4. Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.

---

### 2. Card Types

| Color | Card | Value | Effect |
|-------|------|-------|--------|
| Red, Green, Blue, Yellow | Number 0–9 | 0–9 points | None |
| Same colors | Skip | 20 points | Skips next player |
| Same colors | Reverse | 20 points | Reverses play direction |
| Same colors | Draw Two | 50 points | Next player draws 2 cards and loses turn |
| Any color | Wild | 50 points | Player chooses next color |
| Any color | Wild Draw Four | 100 points | Player chooses next color; next player draws 4 cards and loses turn |

*Wild Draw Four may only be played if the player has no matching color cards. If challenged and found illegal, the player must draw 4 cards instead.*

---

### 3. Gameplay

| Turn | Actions | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| 1 | **Draw** | If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately. |
| 2 | **Play** | Place one card from your hand onto the discard pile that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top card. |
| 3 | **Declare UNO** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. |
| 4 | **End Turn** | If you played your last card, you win the round. If you didn’t, the next player takes their turn. |

---

### 4. Special Rules

| Rule | Description |
|------|--------------|
| **Uno Call** | If you forget to say “UNO” and another player notices before the next player takes their turn, you must draw two penalty cards. |
| **Challenge Wild Draw Four** | If you suspect the previous player used a Wild Draw Four illegally, challenge them. If correct, the challenger draws 4 cards; if wrong, the challenger draws 6 cards. |
| **Stacking** | Some house rules allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards. If a player receives a Draw Two, they may play another Draw Two to pass the penalty to the next player. |
| **Card Replacement** | If you’re playing with a custom deck, replace missing cards with blank cards of the same color. |
| **House Variations** | Many groups add variations such as “Stacking”, “Seven-O”, “Jump-In”, etc. Clarify before starting. |

---

### 5. Scoring

| Condition | Points |
|-----------|--------|
| Winning round | Sum of all cards in opponents’ hands |
| Card values | Number cards = face value; Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20; Wild = 50; Wild Draw Four = 100 |
| End of game | First player to reach 500 points (or agreed total) wins. |

---

### 6. Ending the Game

| Scenario | Outcome |
|----------|---------|
| A player reaches the target score | Game ends; that player is the overall winner |
| All cards are drawn and no one can play | Shuffle discard pile (except top card) to form new draw pile and continue |

---

### 7. Quick Reference Cheat Sheet

| Situation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| No playable card | Draw one; play if possible |
| One card left | Say “UNO!” |
| Illegal Wild Draw Four | Challenge; penalty applies |
| Opponent says “UNO” incorrectly | They must draw two cards |

---

**Enjoy your game!**  
Feel free to tweak house rules to suit your group. Happy playing!
